# Request headers

Add, override or remove headers before the request reaches the app.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `requestHeaders` |
| **Category** | Transform |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `setHeaders` | key/value map | no | — | Set on the request before it reaches your app. An empty value removes a client-supplied header. |
| `removeHeaders` | list of text | no | — | Dropped before forwarding, applied before Set headers. Example: `X-Powered-By`. |
